answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 14566 Country: India Title: (1) if my non muslim brothers called me for a lunch/dinner for a halal food. Can I attend?(2) whether i can recite allahumma atamani vasqin man saqani after eating the food of him? please clarify. Question: (1) if my non muslim brothers called me for a lunch/dinner for a halal food. Can I attend?(2) whether i can recite allahumma atamani vasqin man saqani after eating the food of him? please clarify. Answer ID: 14566 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1251/963=L/1430) (1) Yes, you can join him: ولا ب أ س بالذھاب إلی ضیافۃ أھل الذمۃ (الھندیۃ 5:426، بیروت) (2) Yes, you can recite the above-mentioned dua after having the meal with a non-Muslim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
